instincts.action: List per-issue artifacts (showcases, ELI5s, plans, drafts) and check each against issue state plus repo-wide reference search before touching anything.
instincts.trigger: A PR just merged or a milestone closed and the repo gained explainers, plans, or drafts along the way.

instincts.action: Ask the operator which home and naming to use instead of inventing docs/ paths in a repo you have never seen.
instincts.trigger: Keeper files live in scratch dirs or repo root and no conventional reports folder exists.

instincts.action: Keep the file and name the failed check (issue still open, live references, or unproven shipment) rather than deleting on suspicion.
instincts.trigger: An obsolescence check cannot run or returns ambiguous evidence.

instincts.action: Relocate with copy-verify-delete and update discovered references, then report old path, new path, and reference updates as table rows.
instincts.trigger: A live-knowledge file sits outside the repo's documentation structure or under a meaningless working name.

instincts.action: Treat dated finding reports with live conclusions as knowledge regardless of age; never feed them to the obsolescence test.
instincts.trigger: Temptation to prune by file age or to sweep docs/ indiscriminately.
